Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! This pitch is not easy to bat on, and Sri Lanka Women do have some quality in their ranks. But looking at India Women's batting depth this should be an interesting contest. Stay tuned for the second essay!

Sri Lanka Women would be disappointed with their batting performance here. They did get on a positive start with Hasini Perera playing some beautiful shots. While wickets were tumbling at the other end, Hasini Perera ensured to keep the scoreboard ticking. However, she departed after a fine knock of 37 and after a couple of more wickets, Sri Lanka Women found themselves in a spot of a bother as they were reeling at 84 for 5. Nilakshi de Silva and Anushka Sanjeewani stitched together 47 runs and did some damage repair. But they too could not hold on till the end. Eventually, they were sent packing after putting only 171 runs on the board.

A good toss to lose for India Women! Harmanpreet Kaur mentioned she wanted to bat first as well, but she would be smiling after their show with the ball. It's been a collective bowling performance from the visitors. Their pacers and spinners ran through Sri Lanka Women's batting lineup. One thing that they did well, was not let any batters settle down and as a result, there were not many partnerships stitched in this innings. They picked up wickets at regular intervals and made sure not to leak many runs. Renuka Singh and Deepti Sharma grabbed three wickets, while Pooja Vastrakar chipped in with two scalps. Overall a good show from the tourists and they have an opportunity here to take a 1-0 lead.

It's been a satisfactory recovery from Sri Lanka Women! But Harmanpreet Kaur and her troops will definitely be the happier side going into the break. They have put on a stupendous bowling performance here and have bundled out Sri Lanka Women for a below-par score of 171. Batting is not easy on this wicket, but India Women would fancy their chances of chasing this one down.

OUT! TIMBER! Deepti Sharma finishes the innings off! She grabs her third wicket and Sri Lanka Women have been bundled out! A fuller ball, outside off, spinning in a tad. Rashmi de Silva gets down on her knee and tries to sweep this one but she misses and the ball goes onto shatter the stumps. Sri Lanka Women have been bowled out for 171!
An appeal for LBW, but turned down! A shorter ball, spinning in, around middle. Rashmi de Silva tries to flick this but she misses. That was probably sliding down leg.
Achini Kulasuriya is the last batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Pooja Vastrakar has got India Women one wicket away from wrapping up this innings! Short delivery angling down leg, Inoka Ranaweera goes for the pull. Gets a faint tickle from the under part of the glove and falls towards Yastika Bhatia who dives forward to her right and gets hold of the ball. The umpire wants to check with his square leg partner if the catch was taken cleanly. The third umpire is reviewed and he confirms that there is nothing wrong! Sri Lanka Women now looking less likely that they will play out all 50 overs.
Commentary.Howout: c Yastika Bhatia b Pooja Vastrakar

Commentary.Commentary: The umpires check if Yastika Bhatia has taken the catch cleanly! The soft signal is out. The replay rolls in and it confirms that the catch has been taken cleanly.
Middle stump line from a good length. Worked towards square leg, single attempted and refused immediately.
FOUR! Good shot from Inoka Ranaweera! Good length delivery on middle, Inoka Ranaweera gets a hold of this one and dispatches it through mid-wicket for a lovely boundary!
WIDE! full delivery going down leg. Inoka Ranaweera decides against playing at it.
Full and pitching outside leg, Rashmi de Silva misses her flick shot and hits her pads. The appeal turned down by the umpire and the batter run one.
Goes short and angled into the batter. Pulled to deep square leg for a single

FOUR! Lucky boundary for a Inoka Ranaweera! Flies over slip as she tries to drive a full delivery outside off. The slip fielder dives to her left but the ball runs away to the third man fence for four crucial runs.
Pooja Vastrakar (4-0-16-1) comes back to bowl.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad goes full on off and gets the ball to turn away. Rashmi de Silva leaves this one alone!
Goes for the reverse sweep this time to a ball that is a fraction shorter. Same result as she is unable to connect.
Attempts to sweep a full delivery outside off but does not connect.
Spinning in from outside off, Inoka Ranaweera works this full delivery with soft hands towards mid-wicket and gets a single.
Much better shot from Rashmi de Silva as she plays this full delivery through covers for a single.
Full and outside off. Rashmi de Silva goes for a wild swing a misses.
Full and outside off. Driven firmly towards mid off.
Slower delivery on middle stump from a good length. Rashmi de Silva waits on the ball and turns it towards short fine leg for a single.
Another fuller one, on the pads now. Rashmi de Silva flicks it towards deep square leg for a brace. Good running!
Sticks with her full length, around middle this time. Inoka Ranaweera pushes it down to long on for a single.
Another fuller one, outside off. Inoka Ranaweera drives but she misses.
Pitched up, outside off. Inoka Ranaweera drives and finds the fielder at cover.
On the pads now, fuller ball. Inoka Ranaweera flicks it to squaree leg for a single.
Full, outside off, spinning away. Inoka Ranaweera tries to drive this one but she misses.
Tosses this one up, around middle. Inoka Ranaweera drives it back to the bowler.
Fraction shorter now, around middle. Inoka Ranaweera blocks it out.
Turning in sharply, fuller one, around middle. Rashmi de Silva sweeps this one towards deep square leg for a single.
Shorter ball, spinning in sharply, around the leg pole. Rashmi de Silva looks to flick but she misses. Harmanpreet Kaur with a loud appeal for LBW, but the umpire says no.
Full and pitching outside leg. Hits the pad and Renuka Singh appeals but she knows that one is not out.
Inoka Ranaweera is the new batter in.

OUT! BOWLED! Renuka Singh is running through the Sri Lanka Women tail! Slower delivery once again and Oshadi Ranasinghe is too early into the shot and misses it completely. Gets cleaned up and Sri Lanka Women seem to be faltering a bit here.
Good-length delivery outside off, driven on the up to deep cover for a single.
Bowls a slow leg cutter once again outside off. Rashmi de Silva plays all over this one and gets beaten.
Full and outside off, Oshadi Ranasinghe strokes this to deep cover-point for a single.

FOUR! Welcome boundary for Sri Lanka Women! Oshadi Ranasinghe slashes hard at a full and wide delivery and manages to get a thick enough edge to make the ball fly towards the third man boundary for some useful runs!
On middle, tad fuller. Rashmi de Silva hangs back and tries to sweeps this away but she misses.
Shorter one, spinning in, around middle. Rashmi de Silva stays in her crease and defends it out once again.
Flatter, on middle. Rashmi de Silva blocks it from within her crease.
Wide! Sharp turn there! A short one, this one lands around middle and spins down the leg side. Rashmi de Silva leaves it alone. Wide called!
Tosses this one up, very full, around middle. Rashmi de Silva squeezes it back to the bowler.
This spins in from outside off, shorter in length. Rashmi de Silva tucks it towards square leg.
Outside off, shorer one. Rashmi de Silva pushes it off the back foot towards cover.
Renuka Singh bowls a full delivery outside off and gets Rashmi de Silva to drive but she mistimes it towards mid-wicket and gets off the mark.
Rashmi de Silva, the deutant walks out to bat.

OUT! LBW! The change in bowling works once again from India Women! Renuka Singh bowls a lovely slower delivery full and in line with the stumps. Nilakshi de Silva shuffles across, misses the leg cutter, and gets rapped on her pads. After a prolonged appeal the finger slowly goes up! Sri Lanka Women lose another one.
Full outside off, Placed through covers for a single.
Good-length delivery just outside off, Oshadi Ranasinghe hangs her bat out but the shape away beats the bat.
Straying down leg once again from a good length, Flicked down to fine leg for a single.
Great delivery this one from Renuka Singh as she pitches this one on middle and gets it to shape away from a good length. Nilakshi de Silva tries to work this leg side and gets beaten all ends up.
WIDE! Begins with a loose delivery angling down leg side. Renuka Singh will have to bowl that one again.
Full and wide outside off, Nilakshi de Silva gets down the wicket to the pitch of the delivery and flicks it to square leg for a single.
Shorter ball, this one lands around off and spins in around middle. Nilakshi de Silva shuffles across and tucks it to the fielder at short fine leg.
On middle, quicker and flatter. Nilakshi de Silva blocks it out.
Pitches this one up, around middlle. Oshadi Ranasinghe sweeps this one aerially in the vacant mid-wicket region for a run.
Back of a length again, around middle. Nilakshi de Silva pushes it off the back foot towards long on for a run.
Shorter ball, spinning in sharply, around middle and leg. Nilakshi de Silva tucks it towards the fielder at short fine leg.
Huge appeal for LBW and that looks quite close. Spinning in from outside off on a full length. Oshadi Ranasinghe tries to sweep this but misses and gets hit on the pads. The umpire remains unmoved.
Slightly short and on middle. Oshadi Ranasinghe knocks this back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, Nilakshi de Silva sweeps it towards square leg and takes a quick single.
Full and wide, Cuts it past point for a single.
WIDE! Straying down leg side and called wide!
Shorter one, outside off. Nilakshi de Silva cuts it towards backward point for a single.
Full and flighted outside off, Nilakshi de Silva goes forward and plays at it, gets a thick outside edge to third man for a couple of runs.
Outside off, fuller in length. Oshadi Ranasinghe leaves it alone.
On middle, pitched up delivery. Oshadi Ranasinghe blocks this one.
Full, outsie off. Oshadi Ranasinghe misses her drive.
Pitched up delivery, outside off. Defended.
On middle, fuller ball. Oshadi Ranasinghe blocks it out.
Fuller, outside off. Nilakshi de Silva pushes it towards cover for a single.
Oshadi Ranasinghe is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Rajeshwari Gayakwad has bowled a wonderful over here and has been justly rewarded! Full once again and outside off, Anushka Sanjeewani goes for the sweep again but this time gets a faint bottom edge as the ball spins away and stays low. Yastika Bhatia does well to stay low to take a fine catch! Much needed breakthrough for India Women as this partnership was building!
Commentary.Howout: c Yastika Bhatia b Rajeshwari Gayakwad

Commentary.Commentary: BYES! That is a beauty of a delivery! Not only beats the batter but also the keeper! Full delivery pitching on middle, turns sharply away from the batter and beats the bat. The keeper goes leg side to collect but the ball turns so much that she is left stranded. Two runs taken as byes.
Big turn for Rajeshwari Gayakwad as she pitches this outside off and it turns up till the wide line. Anushka Sanjeewani goes for a sweep and does not connect.
Fraction short this time and spinning outside off. Anushka Sanjeewani tries to slash at it and misses.
Full once again on off. Anushka Sanjeewani chooses to defend this back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, Anushka Sanjeewani continues to sweep the ball as she gets this one wide of the deep square leg fielder for a brace.
Pitches this one up, around middle. Nilakshi de Silva steps down the track and flicks it towards square leg.

A huge shout for an LBW, but turned down! Fuller one, spinning in, around middle. Nilakshi de Silva shuffles across and tries to flick this but she misses and gets hit on her pads. That was probably sliding down leg.
Loopy ball, full, around middle and off. Anushka Sanjeewani sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length, spinning in, around middle and leg. Anushka Sanjeewani stays in her crease and flicks the fielder at square leg.
Pitches it up now, loopy ball, around middle. Nilakshi de Silva dances down the track and knocks it to long on for a single.
A shorter one, spinning in, around middle. Nilakshi de Silva tries to flick this one but she misses.
Attempts another sweep but this is full outside off. Anushka Sanjeewani does not connect and the keeper whips the bails off.
Flighted full and angling into the pads, Nilakshi de Silva sweeps this to deep square leg for a single.
Sharp turn for Rajeshwari Gayakwad as she pitches this full outside off. colelcted by the keeper.
Sweeps this ball from outside off to deep square leg for a single.
BIg turn but way outside off, Rajeshwari Gayakwad leaves this one alone.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad bowls this full and outside off. Nilakshi de Silva drags this across the line and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.

FIVE RUNS! OVERTHROWS! Bouns runs there for Sri Lanka Women! Much-needed though! A length ball, outside off. Nilakshi de Silva dabs it towards point and takes a single. The fielder there has a shy at non-striker's end but she misses. There is no one backing up there and it races away to the fence.
A shorter one, outside off. Nilakshi de Silva ducks underneath it.
Fuller one, outside off. Anushka Sanjeewani lunges forward and taps it towards cover for a quick single.
Another good-length delivery, outside off. Anushka Sanjeewani cuts and finds the fielder at point again.
Outside off, on a length. Anushka Sanjeewani cuts it to the fielder at point.
Tad shorter, around middle. Anushka Sanjeewani pulls it towards deep square leg for a run.
Fuller, around middle and off. Nilakshi de Silva defends this one out.
Floats it up, full, around middle. Anushka Sanjeewani gets down on her knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg for another run.
Well bowled! Slower through the air, full, spinning away. Anushka Sanjeewani presses forward and tries to defend this but she misses.
Full, loopy one, around middle. Nilakshi de Silva sweeps this one towards deep square leg for a single.
Beaten! Lovely delivery! Fuller, this one lands around off and spins away. Nilakshi de Silva tries to block this but she gets beaten.
Tosses this one up, full, around off. Nilakshi de Silva blocks it out.
Length delivery, outside off. Anushka Sanjeewani leaves it alone.
On a length, outside off. Nilakshi de Silva pushes it towards third man for a single.
Tad shorter, outside off. Nilakshi de Silva chops it towards point.
Wide! Another short-pitched delivery, down the leg side this time. Nilakshi de Silva ducks and leaves it alone. Wide called!
A shorter one this time, around middle. Nilakshi de Silva ducks under it and leaves it alone.
Meghna Singh serves a shorter one and outside off. Anushka Sanjeewani cuts it towards deep point for a single.
Fuller one, around middle. Anushka Sanjeewani works it away towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Anushka Sanjeewani knocks this full delivery from outside off towards deep cover for a single.
Shafali Verma bowls this one outside off and fraction short. Anushka Sanjeewani plays this square to the backward point fielder.
Full and on the toes. Anushka Sanjeewani digs it out back to the bowler.
Full and way outside off, Nilakshi de Silva gets a single to deep extra cover.
Flatter, shorter, outside off. Nilakshi de Silva cuts it to the fielder at backward point.
Flighted full outside off, nudged towards point.

DRINKS! India Women are certainly on top here! They have grabbed wickets at regular intervals and have not allowed the batters to stitch a big partnership. Nilakshi de Silva and Anushka Sanjeewani have done well so well. They have put together 25 runs so far and will want to make sure they don not lose any wickets and make this a big one. If Sri Lanka Women can reach anywhere near above 170 that will be decent total!
Back of a length this time but well outside off stump. Anushka Sanjeewani leaves this one alone.
Full and outside off. Anushka Sanjeewani times her shot well to the cover fielder.
Shorter delivery once again and Nilakshi de Silva tries to pull from outside off. Gets a top edge that lands safely in the vacant square leg region. Sri Lanka Women get a single added to their total.
Full and wide from off stump. Driven to deep extra cover for a single.
Back-of-a-length delivery outside off, Anushka Sanjeewani tries to find the gap through cover-point. Cut off by the fielder.
Good-length delivery outside off, Solid in defense.
Meghna Singh (5-0-12-0) is back on!
Full and angled into the pads, Anushka Sanjeewani works this towards long on for a single.  Good over to start off for Shafali Verma.
Quicker delivery outside off and full. Anushka Sanjeewani does well to leave this one alone.
Full on middle once again, Anushka Sanjeewani defends this solidly back to the bowler.
Short and outside off. Thumped towards deep extra cover for a single.
Straighter this time and full. Nilakshi de Silva plays this towards mid on.
Shafali Verma begins with a full delivery outside off, Nilakshi de Silva leaves this one alone.
Shafali Verma comes to bowl.
Pitched up, outside off. Anushka Sanjeewani tries to drive but she gets beaten.
Outside off again, length ball. Nilakshi de Silva cuts it towards point for a single.
Swing and a miss! Slower again, outside off. Nilakshi de Silva stays deep in her crease and tries to slash this but she gets undone by lack of pace.
Slower delivery, outside off, very full. Nilakshi de Silva waits for it and tries to drive this but she gets an inside edge back onto her boot.
Fuller on this occasion, outside off. Anushka Sanjeewani leans and drives it through cover for a single.
Outside off, a length ball. Anushka Sanjeewani leaves it alone.
Goes for the sweep once again, but misses this one as it is flighted full and outside off.
Full outside off. Nilakshi de Silva covers the line and plays it back to the bowler.
Googly once again but this one is wide outside off and slightly short. Nilakshi de Silva cuts this straight to point.
Googly turning into the batter form outside off, Nilakshi de Silva defends this back to the bowler.
FOUR! Nilakshi de Silva is taking the attack to the spinners! Full once again on middle Nilakshi de Silva sweeps this well towards the backward square leg region for another boundary!
Tossed up full and on middle, worked wide off mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter ball, outside off. Nilakshi de Silva ducks and lets that go through to the keeper.
Width on offer this time, outside off. Anushka Sanjeewani slashes this one towards deep point for a single.
Pitched up this time, around middle. Anushka Sanjeewani blocks it off the front foot.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Nilakshi de Silva rocks back and cuts it towards point.
Pooja Vastrakar drops it short now, around middle. Nilakshi de Silva ducks underneath it.
Fuller ball, outside off. Anushka Sanjeewani leans forward and pushes it towards cover. Single taken!
Short delivery outside off. Nilakshi de Silva goes back on the crease and cuts it towards point.
Full once again outside off, Nilakshi de Silva goes on the front foot this time and plays it back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, Nilakshi de Silva covers the line and plays it back to the bowler off the back foot.
Full, flighted ball, around middle. Anushka Sanjeewani sweeps this one towards deep square leg for a single.
Wide! Fuller ball, slower through the air, down the leg side. Anushka Sanjeewani misses her flick. Wide called!
Well bowled! Loopy ball, a leg-break, outside off. Anushka Sanjeewani gets beaten on the outside edge while trying to drive this one.
Fuller one, tosses it up, around middle and leg. Anushka Sanjeewani sweeps it towards short fine leg.

FOUR! Poor fielding at the boundary! This one is full and angling down leg. Nilakshi de Silva flicks this one towards mid-wicket with good timing and it runs towards the fence. The fielder dives over the ball and concedes a much-needed boundary for Sri Lanka Women!
Full outside off, knocked back to the bowler.
Shortish ball, outside off. Anushka Sanjeewani stays in her crease and cuts it late towards third man for a single.
Full delivery shaping away from off stump. Anushka Sanjeewani plays this watchfully towards point.
Beaten this time! Good-length delivery, outside off, shaping away. Anushka Sanjeewani tries to block this one but she beaten on the outside edge.
A length ball, around off. Anushka Sanjeewani blocks it off the back foot.
Full, around middle. Nilakshi de Silva pushes it back to the bowler.
Shorter, quicker, outside off. Anushka Sanjeewani pushes it off the back foot and she rotates the strike!
Floats this one up, full, on middle. Nilakshi de Silva sweeps it aerially towards deep square leg. The fielder there collects the ball on a bounce. Single taken!
Full, flighted ball, around middle. Anushka Sanjeewani strokes it down to long on for a single. She gets off the mark!
Nicely tossed up again, very full, on middle. Nilakshi de Silva knocks it straight down the ground. The fielder from long on will cut it out. Single taken!
A beauty to begin with! Tosses this one up, it lands around off and spins away. Nilakshi de Silva leans to drive but she gets beaten on the outside edge.
Harleen Deol comes to bowl now.
Fuller delivery first up for Anushka Sanjeewani outside off, knocks it towards cover.
Anushka Sanjeewani is the new batter in.

OUT! LBW! Sri Lanka Women have lost half their team here! Back-of-a-length delivery in line with the stumps, Harshitha Madavi tries to play across the line but she misses as the ball stays really low and thuds against the pads. The easiest of decisions for the umpire as this one is plumb! Sri Lanka Women in danger of being bowled out early here!
Pooja Vastrakar is a bit too short with this one pitching on leg, Nilakshi de Silva tucks this towards square leg for a single.

FOUR! A streaky boundary from Nilakshi de Silva! Fraction short and outside off, getting Nilakshi de Silva to slash at it hard. Gets a thick outside edge that flies to the right and over the slip fielder to the third-man fence for a boundary!
Slower delivery, full and attacking the stumps. Flicked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Back-of-a-length delivery cramping the batter for room. Harshitha Madavi gets on her toes and fends it towards cover.
Pooja Vastrakar is introduced into the attack.
Full delivery on off, Harshitha Madavi works this to cover.
Full and outside off, Harshitha Madavi mistimes her sweep and lobs it into the vacant short fine leg region.
Shorter and outside off. Goes back on the crease and plays it to point.
Short from Deepti Sharma outside off, Harshitha Madavi slashes this uppishly past the point fielder for a brace.
Slower delivery flighted full on middle. Harshitha Madavi plays it towards point.

Lovely delivery! A fuller one, this one lands around off and spins away. Harshitha Madavi presses forward and tries to drive but she misses. Yastika Bhatia collects the ball and whips the bails off. The replay shows that Harshitha Madavi's back foot was grounded on time.
Full and on middle. Nilakshi de Silva defends this back to the bowler.

FOUR! Nilakshi de Silva gets her first boundary! Full and outside off, Nilakshi de Silva charges down the track and drags the ball from the inner half of his bat towards the mid-wicket fence for a boundary!
Goes for the sweep again to a fuller ball, outside off. But Nilakshi de Silva misses it this time.
Another fuller one from 'round the wicket to the left-hander, around middle and leg. Harshitha Madavi gets down on her knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg for another run.
Tosses this one up, fuller this time, around middle. Nilakshi de Silva sweeps this one towards deep square leg for a single.
Fraction shorter, outside off. Nilakshi de Silva pushes it off the back foot towards cover.
Short and wide once again. Slashed straight to point.
Harshitha Madavi goes for a wild sweep and misses the line off the ball as it turns away from middle.
Shorter this time outside off, Harshitha Madavi cuts this towards point.
Full on leg, worked back towards the left of the bowler.
Play and miss from Harshitha Madavi. Middle stump line and turning away.
FOUR! That should release some pressure! Outside off, shorter one. Harshitha Madavi stays in her crease and cuts it late past the short third man fielder for a boundary.
Fuller, around middle and off. Nilakshi de Silva blocks it out. End of yet another successful over for India Women!
Nilakshi de Silva walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! Two wickets in two overs for India Women! Sri Lanka Women are now 4 down. Harmanpreet Kaur gets rid of Kavisha Dilhari. A soft dismissal! Shorter one this time, around middle and leg, not much turn there. Kavisha Dilhari stays in her crease and tries to flick this about the ball goes off the leading edge towards mid-wicket. Shafali Verma takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Shafali Verma b Harmanpreet Kaur

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! Goes down leg stump after pitching on middle. Sri Lanka Women get an extra run.
Tossed up full on off, Harshitha Madavi gets her bat down and digs it out towards covers for a single.
Shorter on off and turning away further. Harshitha Madavi shoulders her arms to this one.
Full this time on middle. Harshitha Madavi hits this uppishly past the non-striker towards mid off.
Fraction short on off, Harshitha Madavi goes back on the crease and punches it towards cover.
Outside off, fuller one. Kavisha Dilhari leans and defends this one out.
Kavisha Dilhari comes to the crease.

OUT! LBW! India Women have struck just when Sri Lanka Women were building a partnership! Deepti Sharma grabs her second wicket and gets rid of a set batter. Tosses this one up, full, this one lands around middle and turns away just a tad. Hasini Perera gets down on her knee and tries to sweep this one but she misses and gets hit on her back pad. A huge appeal for LBW, and the umpire says out! Hasini Perera departs after a good start!
Nicely tossed up, very full, around middle. Harshitha Madavi drives this one towards deep cover for a single.
Full on middle stump. defended back to the bowler.
Full on off, Harshitha Madavi sweeps this one with power towards deep mid-wicket. A diving save from Shafali Verma restricts the batters to a brace.
Deepti Sharma changes ends and starts off with a lovely delivery turning away from the middle stump. Harshitha Madavi is beaten off the back foot.
Full on off stump this time, with some extra bounce. Hasini Perera does well to play this towards covers and keep it down.
Full and on leg stump once again. Spins away and beats the bat as the ball stays low.
Full and on off, Hasini Perera works it towards covers and takes off for a single. Harshitha Madavi sends her back.
Full and on middle. Hasini Perera tries to sweep but misses the turning ball.
What a delivery! Full and pitching on leg, spins sharply and beats Hasini Perera's outside edge.
Harmanpreet Kaur flights this one full on middle. Hasini Perera defends this firmly.
Swept away again! Loopy ball, outside off, fuller as well. Hasini Perera gets down on her knee and sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for another run. She retains the strike!
Outside off, pitched up, hint turn there. Harshitha Madavi shuffles across and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Tosses it up, full, around middle. Hasini Perera sweeps and finds the fielder at deep square leg. Single taken!
Tad shorter, this one lands around middle and spins in. Hasini Perera misses her flick and gets hit on her pads.
Shorter one from over the wicket now, outside off. Hasini Perera uses the depth of the crease and blocks it out.
Pitched up, tad quicker, around middle. Hasini Perera sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket. Shafali Verma runs and dives to her left and makes a good stop. Two taken!

DRINKS! The players will take a quick cooling break to reassess their position in the game. Sri Lanka Women have lost 2 early wickets including their skipper Chamari Atapattu. Her opening partner Hasini Perera has looked good though and there is a good partnership building here with Harshitha Madavi. India Women have bowled well and there is a lot in the wicket for the spinners. The match is at an interesting junction and both teams will look to capitalize in these middle overs.

Two byes! Fuller one, outside off. Harshitha Madavi shuffles across and tries to sweep this one but she misses. Yastika Bhatia fails to stop the ball as well. It rolls towards third man and the batters take two byes!
Outside off, spinning away, fuller one. Harshitha Madavi taps it to the fielder at point.
Fuller, around middle this time. Hasini Perera sweeps this one towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Firing it on the pads, fullish ball. Hasini Perera looks to flick this one but she misses.
Attacking the stumps again, fuller ball. Hasini Perera pushes it back to the bowler.
On middle, much fuller. Hasini Perera blocks it out watchfully.
Pulls her length back now, outside off. Harshitha Madavi uses the depth of her crease and pushes it to cover.
Wide of off, fuller one. Hasini Perera sweeps this one from outside off towards mid-wicket for another run.
Fuller this time, outside off, spinning in late. Hasini Perera tries to cut this away but she misses.
Back of a length, around middle. Harshitha Madavi pulls this along the ground towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Sticks to her length, around off. Harshitha Madavi pushes it to cover off the back foot.
Sharp turn! Shorter one, turning in, around off. Harshitha Madavi stays in her crease and does well to block this one.
Shorter one, outside off. Harshitha Madavi stays in her crease and pushes it towards cover and takes a single.
Slower through the air now, fuller, around middle. Harshitha Madavi miscues her scoop shot towards fine leg for a brace.
A bit of yes and no in the middle, but no harm done! Outside off, touch shorter. Harshitha Madavi dabs it towards point.
Pitched up again, around middle. Harshitha Madavi looks to drive but the ball goes off the inner half back to the bowler.
Full now, outside off. Harshitha Madavi drives and finds the fielder at point.
Harmanpreet Kaur begins with a shorter one, around middle. Hasini Perera pushes it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Quicker, outside off, tad fuller. Harshitha Madavi blocks it towards mid off.
Full delivery outside off. Harshitha Madavi gets forward and fends it back towards the bowler.
Quicker, full and on middle. Harshitha Madavi defends it out.
FOUR! Lovely shot! That will release some pressure! Pitched up now, outside off. Harshitha Madavi leans and drives it through cover for a boundary.
Slower through the air, spinning in sharply again, around off, some extra bounce there as well. Harshitha Madavi stays in her crease and does well to fend it away.
Tad shorter, outside off, spinning in. Harshitha Madavi blocks it out towards cover.
Wide! Sharp turn straightaway! A fuller one, this one lands around middle and spins down the leg side. Wide called!
Rajeshwari Gayakwad comes to bowl now!
Flights this full on off stump. Hasini Perera goes for the sweep and gets a top edge that lobs over square leg into a vacant area allowing the batters to complete two runs.
Fraction shorter outside off, Harshitha Madavi works this towards cover with much more control this time for a single.

FOUR! That is a release shot from Harshitha Madavi. Deepti Sharma goes a fraction fuller outside off. Harshitha Madavi swings wildly and gets a thick outside edge that flies to the right of the gully fielder for a boundary to wide third man!
Make that three in a row! Deepti Sharma is bowling a lovely line on middle and getting the ball to turn sharply. Harshitha Madavi is bambozzled!
Beaten once again! Similar delivery and Harshitha Madavi tries to push at it hard but nowhere close to the ball.
Harshitha Madavi has no idea how to play Deepti Sharma. Beaten on the outside edge to a full delivery pitching on middle and spinning away.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now, there can be 4 fielders placed outside the inner circle till the 40th over!
Length ball, around middle and leg. Hasini Perera flicks it off the back foot towards deep square leg for brace.
Touch fuller now, around middle. Hasini Perera drives and finds the fielder at mid on.
Good-length delivery, around middle and leg. Harshitha Madavi shuffles across and flicks it to deep square leg for a single. She gets off the mark with that!
Meghna Singh pulls her length back a tad, on the pads on this occasion. Hasini Perera tucks it towards square leg and rotates the strike.
Another full delivery, outside off again. Hasini Perera pushes it to the fielder at mid off.
Fuller one, outside off. Hasini Perera drives a bit uppishly this time, and the fielder at cover collects it on a bounce.
Full and on off. Harshitha Madavi defends this towards short cover. That will a maiden for Deepti Sharma!
fuller one, spinning away, outside off. Harshitha Madavi leaves it alone.
Deepti Sharma goes wide from off stump and bowls it full. Harshitha Madavi covers the stumps and leaves the ball alone.
Deepti Sharma gets this one close to the stumps and spins away, Harshitha Madavi has no answers to these deliveries as she gets beaten once again.
Deepti Sharma bowls this one full and turns away from off stump, Harshitha Madavi chooses to let the one go to the keeper.

Huge appeal! Deepti Sharma getting some turn here and making it difficult for the batter. Flighted full on off and spinning away from the left-hander, Harshitha Madavi lunges for the ball and misses it completely.
Full and aimed at the toes, Hasini Perera gets her bat down in time and flicks it towards mid-wicket.
On a good length aimed at the pads, Hasini Perera tucks this towards square leg.
Similar delivery, and Hasini Perera goes for a shot but finds the cover fielder.
Full-length delivery once again but this time on an off stump line. Defended towards covers.
Meghna Singh goes full on leg, Hasini Perera flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Shorter length once again on leg, Hasini Perera gets on her toes and fends it towards the leg side.
WIDE! Meghna Singh bangs this in really short on a middle stump line. Hasini Perera watches it go over her head as it is called wide.
Harshitha Madavi is the new batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! Wickets in quick succession for India Women! Deepti Sharma strikes in her first over and Hansima Karunaratne departs without troubling the scorers. A tossed up delivery, around off, full in length. Hansima Karunaratne steps down the wicket and tries to go over mid off but fails to get any elevation. The ball goes off her bottom of the bat and to Pooja Vastrakar at mid off who pouches it safely.
Commentary.Howout: c Pooja Vastrakar b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: Goes full from around the wicket, angling into the batter. Hansima Karunaratne defends and gets an inside edge onto her pads.
Goes short once again and Hasini Perera steps back and slashes it through point for a single.
FOUR! Hasini Perera is looking lethal here. Full delivery outside off, she gets down on her knees and thumps this through the wide mid-wicket region for another boundary!
Slightly short and outside off, fended towards the off side.
Deepti Sharma gets huge turn to start off proceedings. Full and outside off, the ball turns further away from the batter.
It's time for some spin as Deepti Sharma is introduced into the attack.
Back-of-a-length delivery on off, Hansima Karunaratne gets behind the line of the ball and defends towards short cover.
Full and much wider from off stump. Hansima Karunaratne goes for an expansive drive in the air that almost carries to the point fielder.
Meghna Singh goes a fraction shorter and outside off, there is an extra bit of bounce off the surface and beats Hansima Karunaratne once again.
Good-length delivery outside off, keeps slightly low as Hansima Karunaratne tries to play at it and misses.
Full delivery shaping away from the batter from outside off. Hansima Karunaratne fends this towards cover.
Outside off, fuller one. Hasini Perera lunges forward and drives through cover. This time there is protection in the deep. Only a single.
Fuller one, outside off. Hansima Karunaratne pushes it straight down the ground. The ball goes on to hit the stumps at the non-striker's end.
On a length, darting it on the pads. Hasini Perera tucks it through square leg and takes a single.
Overpitched delivery, around middle. Hasini Perera pushes it back to the bowler.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Hasini Perera blocks it out off the back foot.
FOUR! Top shot! Hasini Perera is looking in fine touch! Fuller one, wide of off. Hasini Perera leans forward and drives it through cover for a boundary.
Beaten! On a length, shaping away, outside off. Hasini Perera tries to defend this one but she gets beaten on the outside edge.
Length ball, outside off. Hansima Karunaratne taps it to the fielder at point.
Tad shorter, around middle. Hansima Karunaratne tucks it towards square leg.
Outside off, length delivery. Hasini Perera dabs it towards point and rotates the point.
On a length, around middle and leg. Hasini Perera stays in her crease and defends it out.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Pitched up, outside off. Hasini Perera presses forward and drives it through cover for a glorious boundary.
Fullish delivery, around middle and off. Hasini Perera defends it out towards cover.
Back of a length, outside off. Hansima Karunaratne pushes it off the back foot towards cover. End of a successful over from Renuka Singh!
Hansima Karunaratne is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Renuka Singh draws first blood!  An early breakthrough for India Women! This was a length ball, shaping away a tad, outside off. Chamari Atapattu stays in her crease and tries to block this one but the ball goes off the outside edge back to the keeper. Yastika Bhatia takes an easy catch! The Sri Lankan skipper departs for a timid score. A huge wicket for India Women.
Commentary.Howout: c Yastika Bhatia b Renuka Singh

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off, fuller in length. Hasini Perera drives it towards cover for a single.
Full again, tighter line this time, around the off pole. Chamari Atapattu leans to block this but the ball goes off her inner half and towards square leg for a single.
Wide of off this time, full in length. Chamari Atapattu goes for the booming drive but the ball goes off her inside edge and back onto her pads.
Shaping away, outside off, length ball. Chamari Atapattu leaves it alone.
Length, around middle. Hasini Perera blocks it out. Good first over from Meghna Singh!
Full in length, outside off. Hasini Perera pushes it to the fielder at cover.
A length delivery, around middle. Chamari Atapattu works it towards square leg and takes a single.
Pitched up delivery, around middle. Chamari Atapattu walks down the pitch and blocks it out.
A huge shout for an LBW, but turned down! Another length ball, nipping back in, around leg. Meghna Singh misses her tuck and gets hit on her pads. That was probably sliding down leg.
TWO LEG BYES! Begins with a length ball, swinging in, and around the leg pole. Chamari Atapattu looks to flick this but the ball goes off her thigh pads and towards fine leg. Two leg byes taken!
Meghna Singh will take the new ball from the other end.
On a length, around middle. Hasini Perera blocks it out. Good start for Sri Lanka Women, 8 runs off the first over!
FOUR! Another gorgeous drive! Pitched up, outside off. Hasini Perera leans and creams her drive past extra-cover for another boundary in the over.
Outside off this time, fullish ball. Hasini Perera opens the face of the bat and taps it towards point.
On a length, around middle and leg. Hasini Perera tucks it towards square leg.
FOUR! Sri Lanka Women and Hasini Perera are underway in style! Another fuller one, outside off. Hasini Perera presses forward and drives it through cover for a boundary.
Renuka Singh begins with a fuller ball, around off. Hasini Perera blocks it out off the front foot.

Right then, we are done with all the pre-match formalities! We are ready for action to get underway. The players are out in the middle. Chamari Atapattu and Hasini Perera will open the batting for Sri Lanka Women. Renuka Singh will begin the proceedings with the ball. Let's go!
All the players are out in the middle and lined up for their respective national anthems. It will be India's national anthem first, followed by Sri Lanka's.

Harmanpreet Kaur the captain of India Women says that they also wanted to bat first, looking at the wicket, but they have experienced batters and they will look to chase this down. Adds that they have always done well in the ODI format, but there are some areas they can really improve on. Says that she is concerned about the wicket,  as usually they get good pitches but this is a turning track. Informs that they are playing with three seamers and two spinners and two all-rounders.

Chamari Atapattu the skipper of Sri Lanka Women says they will bat first as they have a strong batting lineup. She admits that the match is important, as it is an opportunity to add crucial points for the World Cup. She says India is a good side and they are looking forward to the game. Backs the youngsters and is excited about the game. Confident about the ODI format as well and she says they have played a bit recently along with quite a few T20I games.

Pitch Report - Gamini Perera is down near the pitch. He says there are blue skies and a slight breeze around, quite pleasant at the moment. Adds that this was the same pitch that used between Sri Lanka and Australia hardly any cracks, it's solid underneath, and spinners will come into play. Mentions that it is a no-brainer for the captain winning the toss, they should bat first.

India Women (Playing XI) - Smriti Mandhana, Shafali Verma, Harleen Deol, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Yastika Bhatia (WK), Richa Ghosh, Deepti Sharma, Pooja Vastrakar, Renuka Singh, Rajeshwari Gayakwad, Meghna Singh.

Sri Lanka Women (Playing XI) - Chamari Atapattu (C), Hasini Perera, Hansima Karunaratne, Harshitha Madavi, Kavisha Dilhari, Nilakshi de Silva, Anushka Sanjeewani (WK), Oshadi Ranasinghe, Rashmi de Silva, Inoka Ranaweera, Achini Kulasuriya.
TOSS - Sri Lanka Women have won the toss and they will BAT first!

Sri Lanka Women on the flip side will be coming into this game with some sort of confidence after winning the final T20I. They will be aiming to carry their winning momentum forward. However, they need to step up with the blade this time as their batting is largely dependent on their skipper, Chamari Atapattu. They have also not been at their best in this format in the recent past. They suffered a 2-1 defeat against Pakistan Women in their previous ODI series and will want to change things around. Can they do so? We will find out. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.
